title: Raw semantic proposal shortlist after Luna intake
note: Ranks are navigation only. No proposal is scientifically selected, and imported predecessor results are not treated as support.
criteria: whether the stated falsifier tests the semantic claim or only a narrower model

ranking.meaning: Does an amount frame bind exactly one measured entity?
ranking.evidence: GDT760 amount panels exist, but independent amount/material tags are still required
ranking.falsifier: exact quantitative one-to-one thresholds; rejects measured-material claim if held frames violate them
ranking.step: Freeze amount direction and independently tag 20 held frames on five folios.

ranking.meaning: Does an operation predict a result/state within two fields?
ranking.evidence: GDT702 immediate-right census is a nearby predecessor; independent action/result tags remain needed
ranking.falsifier: latency excess over matched controls directly tests operation reading
ranking.step: Blindly tag action/result status for held two-field windows.

ranking.meaning: Do action fields preserve source-before-target order?
ranking.evidence: GDT311 and GDT386 provide navigation, but independent source-target edges are missing
ranking.falsifier: reversal parity on held fields tests directional argument semantics
ranking.step: Assemble a five-folio source-target edge panel before scoring.

ranking.meaning: Does a material whole concentrate on one independently named part?
ranking.evidence: S104 anchor and GDT351 capacity are related; singular part captions remain insufficient
ranking.falsifier: held concentration versus matched controls tests material-part identity
ranking.step: Audit independent part captions and count eligible folios.

ranking.meaning: Does a whole denote a directional processed state change?
ranking.evidence: GDT625/GDT762 quality paths exist, but independent held quality tags are required
ranking.falsifier: loss of direction against same-quality controls rejects state-change role
ranking.step: Freeze quality tags outside discovery paths.

ranking.meaning: Do local labels point to a specific prose record member?
ranking.evidence: GDT790 has native owner overlays on limited pages; five-folio independent replication is unmet
ranking.falsifier: owner-held transfer versus generic-code controls directly tests indexical pointer claim
ranking.step: Obtain independent panel-owner mappings on two additional folios.

ranking.meaning: Does a record-initial whole point deictically to a visible source?
ranking.evidence: GDT699 is a narrow deictic precedent; many current owners are proximity-only
ranking.falsifier: held native-owner resolution versus opener controls tests deixis
ranking.step: Freeze singular native connectors and exclude proximity-only cases.

ranking.meaning: Does prior mention switch a whole from definite to anaphoric use?
ranking.evidence: GDT573/GDT596 provide prior phrasebook work, not independent owner annotations
ranking.falsifier: first-versus-later owner-cue difference tests article/reference status
ranking.step: Blindly annotate prior-owner history on held records.

ranking.meaning: Does a modifier scope over the next head only?
ranking.evidence: GDT575/GDT577 have modifier topology, but head tags include exploratory assignments
ranking.falsifier: next-head excess versus prior/global alternatives tests scope
ranking.step: Replace exploratory head tags with independent annotations.

ranking.meaning: Does a complete whole select action modality?
ranking.evidence: GDT744/GDT805 context panels exist; independent action/result labels are not complete
ranking.falsifier: ordered action/result framing versus descriptive controls tests operator role
ranking.step: Freeze action/result tags before selecting candidate wholes.

ranking.meaning: Does a closure whole release the record without another action?
ranking.evidence: GDT556 is a nearby closure route; independent record boundaries remain limited
ranking.falsifier: release-without-new-action threshold tests closure scope, not generic terminality
ranking.step: Bind boundaries independently on five folios.

ranking.meaning: Does a unit whole recur across materials while retaining one measure slot?
ranking.evidence: GDT593/GDT760 provide amount context, but independent unit/material identities are unavailable
ranking.falsifier: cross-material recurrence versus material controls tests unit role
ranking.step: Find three independently bound materials before scoring.

ranking.meaning: Does A-B-A resume the same active referent?
ranking.evidence: A-B-A historical frame exists, but independent referent links are sparse
ranking.falsifier: same-owner continuity versus A-B-C/A-C-A controls tests referent return
ranking.step: Adjudicate both A positions on a held five-folio panel.

ranking.meaning: Does a record-initial whole establish a continuing topic?
ranking.evidence: GDT581/GDT791 constrain record interpretation; independent topic labels are incomplete
ranking.falsifier: later-owner continuity versus opener controls tests topic persistence
ranking.step: Freeze record boundaries and topic annotations independently.

ranking.meaning: Does an amount-adjacent whole denote the measured entity rather than an operation?
ranking.evidence: GDT760/GDT804 are close precedents and leave attachment unresolved
ranking.falsifier: directional attachment tests the explicit material-versus-operation rival
ranking.step: Pre-register side and slot labels on held amount fields.

ranking.meaning: Do drawing interruptions reset inherited owner/item state?
ranking.evidence: DIC001 establishes distributed reset likeness, but semantic owner/item coding is not independent
ranking.falsifier: interruption-specific reintroduction versus matched gaps tests state reset, not picture meaning
ranking.step: Freeze owner/item cue tags after DIC001 boundary masking.

ranking.meaning: Do ordinary line breaks preserve owner/item state?
ranking.evidence: GDT791 corrects line-boundary assumptions; independent cross-line owner links remain incomplete
ranking.falsifier: line-break continuity versus interruption penalty tests nonreset, not clausehood
ranking.step: Compare held line pairs with independently tagged owners.

ranking.meaning: Do register-transition edges carry handoff roles?
ranking.evidence: post-IL023 and GDT790 provide class/owner scaffolds, but edge-specific binding is absent
ranking.falsifier: ordered edge interaction beyond host class tests handoff role
ranking.step: Inventory held register transitions with frozen edge labels.

ranking.meaning: Must a semantic role survive alternate raw readings?
ranking.evidence: GDT859 supplies alternate-reader alignment; independent role joins and error model are unresolved
ranking.falsifier: valid only for reading-robust locus attachment, not every broad meaning; current broad falsifier overclaims
ranking.step: Repair scope and separate transcription, register, and sparse-support failures.

ranking.meaning: Must a proposed role be excluded from incompatible slots?
ranking.evidence: GDT805/GDT770 provide context panels, but independent incompatible-slot labels are absent
ranking.falsifier: can reject a role only if incompatibility labels are prebound; otherwise it tests the slot model
ranking.step: Freeze compatible/incompatible slot ontology independently.

ranking.meaning: Must same-role wholes be reciprocally frame-compatible?
ranking.evidence: GDT746/GDT807 provide analogy/exchange panels; reciprocal equality is not independently established
ranking.falsifier: valid against context-free interchangeability, invalid against broad shared role; requires repaired alternatives
ranking.step: Split interchangeability, frame inclusion, and shared broad role before any test.
